name: Sajid Hasan
headline: Machine Learning Engineer
shortBio: My Lord, increase me in knowledge
bio:
I'm Sajid, a Software Engineer with a background primarily in AI Engineering.

I've been a science enthusiast for as long as I can remember, with a particular fascination for Mathematics. I'm naturally curious and tend to follow that curiosity wherever it leads, picking up bits and pieces of knowledge across a wide range of subjects along the way.

I also have a deep appreciation for the natural world. I enjoy exploring nature, discovering new places, animals, and learning about geography. In many ways, I'm simply someone who loves understanding how things work and how the world fits together.
